006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
011
012/**
013 * FOER0000: Thrown when an unidentified error occurs during function
014 * evaluation.
015 */
016public class UnidentifiedFunctionError
017    extends FunctionMetapathError {
018  @NonNull
019  private static final IErrorCode ERROR_CODE = IErrorCode.of("FOER", 0);
020
021  /**
022   * the serial version UID.
023   */
024  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
025
026  /**
027   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code message} and
028   * {@code cause}.
029   *
030   * @param message
031   *          the exception message
032   * @param cause
033   *          the original exception cause
034   */
035  public UnidentifiedFunctionError(@Nullable String message, @Nullable Throwable cause) {
036    super(ERROR_CODE, message, cause);
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code message} and no
041   * cause.
042   *
043   * @param message
044   *          the exception message
045   */
046  public UnidentifiedFunctionError(@Nullable String message) {
047    super(ERROR_CODE, message);
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with a {@code null} message and the
052   * provided {@code cause}.
053   *
054   * @param cause
055   *          the original exception cause
056   */
057  public UnidentifiedFunctionError(@Nullable Throwable cause) {
058    super(ERROR_CODE, cause);
059  }
060}
